task.title: Sending an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction to IPOC

step.cmd: Before sending the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) to IPOC, determine if a Level 2 officer must adjudicate any outstanding issues:
In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + 10 business days.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, determine if a decision has been rendered:
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “Convert from CT [12 or 77] to CT [number].”
Remarks line 2: Type “Start w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX], if less than 15 weeks ENT WEEK [XX], ADC w/c [XXXX] or EDC w/c [XXXX], NO-CR Code”. Include the WP details and any other relevant information.

Remarks lines 3 and 4: If an extension of the BP is required, type “Extend [type], start w/c [XXXX], ENT WEEKS [XX]. If a new disentitlement is required or an existing disentitlement must be terminated, type “D[XX] Disentitlement start w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].” If an allocation of earnings is required, type “M175 [type] [amount] [w/c start date] to [w/c end date], [amount, if the last week is different].
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Decision type: Select the appropriate option.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a client Note to send a saved ACS letter:
In ACS, review and send the saved letter.
In NWS, determine if the conversion application was submitted using AW:

ul.li: If yes, go to Subsequent claims . Subsequent claims
